audit.description: What happened, who allowed it, and what the kernel recorded. The record is written on every governed action and nothing in the product can edit it.

empty.title: No audit events yet
empty.body: Control-plane audit events are written by the kernel on every governed action. An empty record means nothing has been done in this organization yet, not that recording is off.

filteredEmpty.title: No events match these filters
filteredEmpty.body: The record holds events outside this filter. Clear the filters to read it from the newest event.

error.title: Audit could not be loaded
error.body: Nothing was changed. Runs kept recording while this page was down: events are written by the kernel, not by the operator console.

denied.title: You cannot see the audit record
denied.body: Signed in as {role}. Needed: an organization owner or admin ({permission}). An owner can grant it, and the grant is itself recorded in the audit record.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Access request {id} is waiting for an owner's decision.
